title: Monterey, California Travel Guide
overview: Monterey combines major attractions with regional outdoor access and historical sites.

thingsToDo.title: Explore Monterey Bay Aquarium
thingsToDo.description: Monterey Bay Aquarium opened in 1984 on Cannery Row in a former sardine cannery, directly linking the institution to Monterey’s industrial waterfront history. It was founded by the David and Lucile Packard Foundation and became internationally recognized for large-scale living exhibits, including a multi-story kelp forest and major open-ocean tanks. The aquarium’s location on Monterey Bay places it within a biologically rich upwelling zone that supports research and public interpretation of Pacific marine ecosystems. Its opening year, adaptive reuse of a historic cannery structure, and role in sea otter and tuna husbandry programs made it a model for modern coastal aquariums and science-based visitor education in California.
